description: Gate 5C exposure-only calibration. Candidate structural event rates are compared with balanced duplication/deletion. The selected rate is the lowest candidate meeting the pre-registered exposure threshold; outcome direction, genome expansion, persistence, population and ecological performance are forbidden selection criteria.
